headline: AceVector schedules its 19th Annual General Meeting for December 2026
summary: AceVector Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the scheduling of its 19th Annual General Meeting. The meeting is set to take place on December 21, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing for the company. Indian retail investors holding shares in AceVector should note the date for participation in shareholder resolutions.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate calendar update for shareholders

summary: AceVector Limited has notified the stock exchange regarding a change in its Corporate Identity Number (CIN). headline: AceVector updates its fair disclosure code for insider trading regulations
summary: AceVector Limited has submitted an intimation under Regulation 8(2) of SEBI's Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. The filing concerns updates to the company's code of practices and procedures for fair disclosure of unpublished price-sensitive information. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing typically required of listed entities. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural corporate governance update has no direct impact on stock prices or financial performance.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for your portfolio or trading strategy.
